tasks.title: Hide weekends in booking calendar
tasks.description: Update the online appointment booking calendar to hide weekends (specifically Saturdays) since the practice is closed on Saturdays. Complete this change before Friday.
criteria: Weekends (Saturday and Sunday) are not selectable/visible in the booking calendar UI
Users cannot book appointments on weekends
Change is deployed/available by the stated deadline

tasks.title: Prepare SMS reminder change request
tasks.description: Create and send a change request including a cost estimate for adding SMS appointment reminders (using Twilio) for delivery 24 hours before appointments.
criteria: Change request document is sent to Dr. Elena Ruiz
Includes cost estimate and scope for Twilio-based SMS reminders
Sent by the stated deadline

tasks.title: Pause SMS work until CR approved
tasks.description: Do not begin implementation of SMS reminders until Dr. Elena Ruiz signs off on the change request.
criteria: No development work on SMS reminders begins prior to written sign-off
Sign-off is recorded/confirmed before any SMS implementation starts

tasks.title: Fix HEIC insurance card uploads
tasks.description: Resolve the issue where iPhone photos in HEIC format fail to upload on the insurance card upload page. This is urgent due to front desk calls.
criteria: HEIC images upload successfully on the insurance upload page
Non-HEIC formats continue to upload successfully
Fix is deployed to the environment used by patients

tasks.title: Retest insurance uploads on mobile
tasks.description: After the HEIC upload fix is deployed, retest the insurance card upload flow on both iPhone and Android devices.
criteria: Upload test passes on iPhone with HEIC images
Upload test passes on Android with common image formats
Results are documented (pass/fail)

tasks.title: Check SPF/DKIM for reset emails
tasks.description: Investigate why password reset emails go to spam in Gmail by checking the SPF/DKIM setup on the client domain with their IT contact.
criteria: SPF/DKIM configuration is reviewed for the sending domain
Findings and recommended changes (if any) are documented and shared with the team/client

tasks.title: Send signed hosting BAA to client
tasks.description: Obtain the signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) from the hosting provider and send it to Dr. Elena Ruiz for her HIPAA compliance file by end of next week (Oct 23).
criteria: Signed BAA is obtained from hosting provider
BAA is sent to Dr. Elena Ruiz
Sent by the stated deadline

tasks.title: Design text-size toggle option
tasks.description: Plan and implement a text-size toggle to help older patients who struggle with small text. Marked as low priority, nice-to-have.
criteria: Text-size toggle is available in the portal UI
Toggling increases/decreases text size across key portal pages

tasks.title: Run full regression test
tasks.description: Conduct a full regression test during the week of Oct 26 ahead of the Nov 2 go-live target.
criteria: Regression test plan/cases are executed across agreed scope
Defects are logged with severity and reproduction steps
Regression testing is completed within the specified week

tasks.title: Schedule front desk training session
tasks.description: Book a 30-minute training session for front desk staff during the week before launch (go-live target Nov 2).
criteria: 30-minute session is scheduled on the calendar within the week before launch
Front desk staff receive the invite and joining details

tasks.title: Schedule next weekly check-in
tasks.description: Set up the next check-in meeting at the same time next week.
criteria: Calendar invite is sent for the same time next week
All attendees are included on the invite
